notes.title: Demo is live & looking good!
notes.content:
[h1]I've been busy cookin & the demo is feeling good![/h1]

[h2]Demo Progress[/h2]
A lot of dev time has been throw towards polishing the core experience and developing systems to enable the development of the remaining levels & chapters! 
I've still got some more magic to weave into the Demo so that we can refine the immersion and give you another area to explore. I'm always looking for ideas and inspiration so please don't hesitate to jump in discord & fire anything & everything my way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278871/8bea5f2adbbbb3a12b057d01ddaf48c99dd6f234.jpg[/img]

[h2]Detailing & PLANTS!![/h2]
Not a clue why, but I'm low-key obsessed with making potted plants to detail out our liminal environments. My goal is that each area should contain some sort of interesting [i]moment[/i] as well as existing in a way where you could imagine this space existing but also questioning the sanity of the person architecting them. Let me know how I'm getting on in that regard because I'm in dire need of some feedback from you lot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278871/64c519bff755e99ccb3ca0decf4ae12a2838d8d3.jpg[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/qUTWzfN7T7]Come join the discord![/url]
